name: inprocess-obi-apb-timer-faster-model-refusal
description: One Ibex RVFI CPU at its pinned 50 MHz declaration and one PULP APB3 timer declared at 60 MHz. The host advances its transaction engine one CPU cycle per tick, so a model declared faster than the reference CPU is refused by name instead of being sub-stepped.
notes: The 60 MHz profile is a declared composition variant of the pinned PULP apb_timer; the pinned 50 MHz profile is not edited.
The expected refusal states the two rates and the contract: "the host advances one CPU cycle per tick and cannot sub-step a faster model".
